listing.name: Genma Onimusha — genma-recomp (rafaelkenedy)
listing.summary: Native Windows player route and modern camera-relative controls documented. Upstream v0.5.1 fixes analog movement through camera cuts by retaining the character’s actual heading through small stick adjustments and clearing retention on guard or other action states. D-pad tank controls and native directional guard steps/dodges remain. Full campaign/completion and package/runtime behavior remain unverified by Portcove. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: USA default.xbe SHA1 08bfe432eb55877b5af2dd401b713743c5b751cd plus game files; ISO Redump/XISO or extracted folder

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README advertises GenmaOnimusha-*-win64.zip v0.5.1. First run imports the owned USA disc/XBE and compiles locally with the bundled compiler; later starts reuse it and rebuild after runtime updates. No release ZIP was downloaded or inspected in this follow-up.
